title: Restoring the neural-plate bioelectric prepattern rescues teratogen and Notch defects

fields.label: Label
fields.value: Restoring the neural-plate bioelectric prepattern rescues teratogen and Notch defects

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: Normal brain morphogenesis in vertebrate (frog) embryos depends on a specific bioelectric prepattern that chemical or genetic teratogens alter; forcing a return to the correct prepattern in the neural plate, for example by activating the HCN2 channel, corrects brain morphology, gene expression and learning capacity in animals exposed to alcohol, nicotine or a dominant Notch mutation.

fields.label: Work
fields.value: The Multiscale Wisdom of the Body: Collective Intelligence as a Tractable Interface for Next-Generation Biomedicine

fields.label: Chapter
fields.value: Levin M 2025, The Multiscale Wisdom of the Body: Collective Intelligence as a Tractable Interface for Next-Generation Biomedicine › Bioelectricity as the Interface to Multicellularity › Birth Defect Repair and Limb Regeneration

fields.label: Quotation
fields.value: Forcing a return to the correct prepattern in the neural plate can correct brain morphology, gene expression, and learning capacity in animals exposed to alcohol, nicotine, or even mutations of the critical neurogenesis gene Notch [124, 125, 126].

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: Levin M, “The Multiscale Wisdom of the Body: Collective Intelligence as a Tractable Interface for Next-Generation Biomedicine”, BioEssays : news and reviews in molecular, cellular and developmental biology (2025), doi:10.1002/bies.202400196; section “Bioelectricity as the Interface to Multicellularity › Birth Defect Repair and Limb Regeneration”. Scope: Xenopus laevis embryos exposed to alcohol, nicotine or Notch mutation (author's lab's prior work, refs [124–126])

fields.label: Assessment
fields.value: GPT-5.6 Sol on levin-2025-wisdom-12: partially-resolvable, resolvability 0.71

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: The interventions, controls and multiple rescue endpoints are explicit. Existing published data likely test individual cases, but uncertain public raw data and cross-study heterogeneity limit resolution of the complete conjunction.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: For alcohol, nicotine and dominant-Notch embryos, compare neural-plate voltage maps, brain anatomy, expression and learning between teratogen-only and HCN2-restored groups. Coordinated rescue without correction of the initiating insult supports the claim.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Learning assays can be confounded by sensory and motor rescue.

Raw voltage, morphology, expression and behaviour may not be linked per animal.

The three teratogens come from separate studies.

fields.value:

operationalizability: 0.95
data existence: 0.5
data adequacy: 0.55
discriminating power: 0.85

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: The rescue design is explicit: teratogen or Notch disruption, a voltage-prepattern measurement, and morphological, molecular, and behavioral endpoints. Those data are in the original experimental reports rather than a repository that can be reanalyzed. Public expression atlases do not include the HCN2-rescue contrast, so the claim waits on data that are not currently available.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: In frog embryos exposed to alcohol, nicotine, or a dominant Notch construct, compare brain morphology, neural-plate markers, and a learning assay with and without forced restoration of the normal voltage prepattern, for example by HCN2. Rescue on all three readouts would support the claim; restoration of voltage without rescue, or rescue without voltage normalization, would refute it.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
No independent open replication covers the rescue design.

Morphology scores, in situ results, and learning performance are not in a public archive.

The three teratogens and the Notch model are separate experiments and would have to be reanalyzed together.
